name: pam_pwhistory
description: Enforce password history to prevent reuse
detailed_description: Password module that enforces password history, preventing users from reusing recent passwords. Configurable number of previous passwords to remember. Works in conjunction with password change modules like pam_unix.

parameters.remember: Number of previous passwords to remember
parameters.retry: Number of attempts to enter new password

notes:
Enforces password history requirements; typically used in password change PAM stack.
